recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic composition featuring three individuals walking forward on an asphalt runway at dusk. The scene is defined by a central, low-horizon lens flare that silhouettes the figures and casts long shadows, set against a moody, purple-toned sky with heavy cloud cover.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure slightly forward of flanking figures to create depth.
Horizon line positioned at the waist level of the subjects.
Light source directly behind the central figure creating a halo effect.
Text layers integrated into the sky and foreground as semi-transparent overlays.
coreInvariants: Purple and desaturated blue color palette.
Asphalt texture with visible yellow runway markings.
Dramatic backlighting from a central point source.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three full-body figures centered horizontally, occupying the middle two-thirds of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white lens flare at the center of the horizon.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the central face, moves down to the walking motion, then upward to the large background typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of sky at the top and asphalt at the bottom provide room for typographic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted indigo and deep purple for the sky and atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm white and pale yellow for the central light source and runway lines.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Steel blue and charcoal for the subjects' clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast at the light source.

letterConstructionRules: Ultra-condensed and tall for background elements
Wide and extended for foreground elements
characterSpecificRedesigns: Thin, hairline strokes for the background text to allow image transparency
Solid, blocky construction for the foreground banner text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme width contrast: ultra-condensed tall background text paired with ultra-extended wide foreground text.
graphicDevices: Translucent horizontal banner at the bottom
Thin horizontal rule lines integrated with text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the ultra-condensed verticality of the background text.
Matches the wide, square-geometric feel of the foreground text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic photo of three people (two men, one woman) walking forward on a dark asphalt airport runway at dusk. The sky is a moody purple-grey with heavy clouds. A bright white light source is positioned on the horizon directly behind the central woman, creating a strong lens flare and backlighting. The woman wears a blue leather jacket and jeans; the men wear dark casual clothing. The ground has faded yellow runway lines.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-condensed, thin-stroke sans-serif text in the upper sky area with 50% opacity. Add a semi-transparent white horizontal bar across the bottom fifth of the image. Inside this bar, place wide, extended geometric sans-serif text in dark grey with very wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the central light source creating a halo effect?
Is the background text tall and thin?
Is the foreground text wide and placed on a translucent bar?
Does the color palette maintain a purple/indigo mood?

adjustableVariables: Width of the bottom translucent bar
Specific clothing styles of the trio
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the individuals
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not obscure the faces.
Check that the lens flare doesn't wash out the entire image.
Verify the perspective of the runway lines matches the subjects' walk.
Confirm the purple sky tone is consistent across the top half.
recipe.reuseFormula: Trio + Runway + Twilight + Backlit Flare + Condensed/Extended Type Contrast
